messages:
sam_engineer: Hey @support — customer case #C-3241. They report their invoice is ~+18k tokens above what the dashboard shows for a streaming request that the client cancelled mid-generation. Customer says they canceled at ~2m25s and closed the SSE connection. Our logs show the server emitted a "final" chunk after the connection closed.

alex_support: Can you paste the request_id and a short timeline? Need customer id and sample frames to triage.

sam_engineer: req_01G7Z8Y2, customer_id: cust_acme. Timeline: client OPEN -> stream partial frames -> client sent CANCEL (client closed connection) -> server flushed final frame ~150ms later. Metering shows both partial tokens (sum=3,200) and final tokens (sum=3,512) on invoice; dashboard only shows the partials.

maria_engineer: Looks like the classic "stream + finalize" double-count. Ingest path currently accepts streaming token events (deltas) and also a separate finalize record that contains total tokens. If we don't dedupe when final arrives we end up summing both. Quick example from logs: 

```
> event: partial
data: {"tokens": 3200, "req_id": "req_01G7Z8Y2"}
...
> event: final
data: {"tokens": 3512, "req_id": "req_01G7Z8Y2", "final": true}
```

maria_engineer: Note the final record reports total tokens (not a delta). Normal flow should replace the deltas with final total. The bug: partials were committed to metering DB; finalize got inserted as an additive record.

alex_support: Can you attach ingest/log IDs and the invoice number so billing can act?

sam_engineer: Invoice: INV-9876. Metering event ids: evt_5a3b (partial series), evt_f9c1 (finalization). I will forward the raw logs to #eng-ml and attach the request trace.

maria_engineer: Repro steps for SRE/QA:
1) Start a streaming generation (deterministic prompt)
2) Let server emit 3 partial deltas (recorded as incremental token events)
3) Immediately close client TCP (simulate cancel)
4) Trigger server finalization path so it emits final total (flush/compaction)
5) Check metering DB: if bug present you will see partial_sum + final_total counted.

maria_engineer: Short-term mitigation: update ingest consumer to dedupe by (req_id, final_flag). Treat "final=true" as authoritative: either replace prior partials or ignore partials if final already committed. Will open a small PR. Need a brief schema note for downstream consumers.

alex_support: For billing ops — if we confirm duplication can we issue a manual credit? @billing_bot please open an adjustment for cust_acme on INV-9876 and mark as "stream double-count pending fix".

billing_bot: ACK: Created adjustment ticket BILL-2245 for cust_acme (INV-9876). Status: pending review by billing_ops.

jordan_ops: I'll hold the invoice and ping the customer with an interim explanation. :thumbsup:

maria_engineer: Implementation plan: attach a small patch to the ingestion lambda to treat final as authoritative and add an e2e that forcibly closes the client (covers TCP/socket shutdown). Also adding a metric for "final_after_client_close" to track frequency.

alex_support: ETA? This is a P2 for the customer.

maria_engineer: PR by EOD, tests + deploy next day. Will post PR link and rollout steps here. :eyes:

sam_engineer: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and leave thread open until BILL-2245 is resolved and the patch is deployed.
